parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance that is associated with the IPv6 address to which the egress-only rule is applied.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the instance to which you want to apply the egress-only rule. Valid values:

*   IPv6Address (default)
*   IPv6Prefix

parameters.name: Ipv6EgressOnlyRuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the egress-only rule that you want to query.

parameters.name: Ipv6GatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the IPv6 gateway.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the IPv6 gateway is deployed. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-ipv6-egress-only-rules --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-gateway-id ipv6gw-bp1rhhs9zjlxukc5e0000 --ipv6-egress-only-rule-id ipv6py-bp1rr7fq1md8pbb3k0000 --name rulename --instance-type Ipv6Address --instance-id ipv6-bp12uzwhac8tv3xx60000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
